# Commit map: the agent-wars history before publication, to the public history
#
# The agent-wars repository's history was filtered before it went public, to keep
# private files out and to give every commit the author's GitHub noreply address.
# Commit messages and dates are unchanged, but every commit hash changed. Hashes cited
# in this repository are from the history before publication. Each line gives the old
# hash, then the new one. A "-" means the commit changed only filtered files and has
# no counterpart in the public history.
#
# Public repository: https://github.com/michael-kitchin/agent-wars
